claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 both show 'brother' script clearly on the machine body.
Small text/model markings near the screen are visible but too small to read in either photo.
A digital screen with a floral/thread graphic is visible, consistent with a computerized embroidery unit, but no power-on or stitching demonstration is shown.
Both photos clearly show 'brother' branding, not Singer; this note conflicts with the witness's visual identification and is treated as unverified outside data, not fact.
